bio: Adam Joseph Hamilton (born July 12, 1964) is an American politician and Methodist minister who is a United States senator-elect from Kansas. A member of the Democratic Party, he is senior pastor of the United Methodist Church of the Resurrection, the largest United Methodist congregation in the United States, based in the Greater Kansas City area.

items.t: Changed his position on homosexuality and supports a pluralist approach to human sexuality in the future United Methodist Church.
items.q: some years ago he changed his mind on homosexuality, and his vision of the future UMC is pluralist when it comes to human sexuality.
